Bei UNITY ist es deine Mission, daraus eine echte unternehmerische Entscheidung für unsere Kunden zu machen: Wohin soll sich die Prozess- und Systemlandschaft bewegen? Was kostet welcher Weg und wer setzt ihn um? Und wie bleibt das Programm steuerbar? Du sitzt auf der Seite des Kunden. Du gestaltest End-to-End-Prozesse, Zielarchitektur und Programmsteuerung.   • KI dort einsetzen, wo sie wirkt: Du identifizierst Use Cases for SAP Business AI und Joule, etwa in der Custom-Code-Analyse, bei der Daten

About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies and we work with SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.


The role

As Head of Operations, you make sure what we sell actually goes live, and that the company behind it runs without friction. Your job is to make our customers successful and to free up the founders, sales and engineering to do the work only they can do.

We are growing from a small founding team into a company that runs several enterprise rollouts at once, works with SAP consultancy partners, and is hiring across engineering, sales and product. That growth needs one person who owns how it all fits together.

You report directly to the founders and our diffrent department Heads. This is not an admin role. Half of it sits right next to the customer.

title: AI Builder
description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. title: Founding AE - UK
description:
Location: London – hybrid

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior


About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will lead technology due diligence engagements for clients who are selling, buying or investing in software companies. Some reviews are paid for by the seller and run in two stages: a private readiness review so the company can fix issues first, then a report that buyers read in the data room. Our first engagements are with data and AI platforms in regulated sectors.

You lead the work day to day. An Intelance engagement partner owns the client relationship and signs off the report, and you work alongside our AI assurance, cloud security, data protection and GxP specialists.

What you will do

  • Review the architecture, code, cloud set up and data pipelines of modern data platforms, such as those built on Google Cloud, BigQuery, dbt, Airflow and Looker.

  • Run code and open source licence scans, and turn the results into clear findings.

  • Interview founders and technical leads, request evidence and review it.

  • Keep the evidence log, so every statement in the report is backed by a document or by two people.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write a fix list the seller can act on.

  • Bring the specialist findings together and write both reports to a standard a buyer's advisers will trust.

What you will bring

  • At least five years in technology due diligence, technical advisory or senior engineering leadership.

  • At least three due diligence reports written as the main author. Experience of a vendor repor

description: APPLICATION DEADLINE: This opportunity will be removed based on applicant volume; we encourage you to apply soon if interested  Who We Are   M-Files is redefining how work gets done. In the early stages of a customer's journey, you'll partner with our Services team to ensure smooth onboarding and successful user adoption.

Airbridge 활용도를 분석해 기능 이해도와 실제 활용 수준을 고도화 합니다.  고객 데이터를 분석하여 인사이트를 도출하고 최적화 방향을 제안합니다.  데이터 파이프라인 및 연동 구조 관련 Engineering Group 및 Data Group과 협력하여 개선 가이드를 제공합니다.  고객사의 요구사항을 바탕으로 Product 팀과 협력하여 제품 개선 방향을 도출합니다.                💡 이런 분을 찾고 있습니다.    3년 이상의 디지털 마케팅(퍼포먼스, CRM, 그로스) 혹은 그 외 동종업계(마케팅 컨설팅사, 대행사, 렙사, 매체사 등) 경험이 있으신 분  논리적으로 사고하고 구조화된 커뮤니케이션(전달력, 문서 작성 능력)이 가능하신 분  생소한 개념(SDK, API, 어트리뷰션 등)에 강한 호기심과 이해력을 바탕으로, 가파른 러닝 커브를 그릴 수 있는 분  책임감 있게 업무를 수행하며 고객사와의 소통을 주도할 수 있는 적극적 태도를 가지신 분  ‘Happy to Help’ 마인드를 바탕으로 지식을 기꺼이 공유하고, 고객 및 동료의 문제 해결에 즐겁게 기여할 수 있으신 분  데이터로 고객의 성과를 진단하고 마케터의 언어로 제안할 수 있는 분                💡 이런 경험을 가진 분이라면 더 좋습니다. description: Vill du kombinera strategiskt ledarskap med operativ närvaro i en verksamhet som växer? Vi på Barkfors i Malmö söker nu en Head of Customer Success som får en central roll i att forma en skalbar leveransorganisation och säkerställa en kundupplevelse präglad av kvalitet och professionalism.   Vi är marknadsledande inom logtech och erbjuder moderna lösningar för transportplanering till företag inom transport- och logistikbranschen. Med över 30 års erfarenhet kombinerar vi gedigen branschkunskap med ny teknik och innovation.  Idag är vi över 30 medarbetare som tillsammans utvecklar våra produkter och vår verksamhet. Hos oss blir du en del av ett mindre bolag med korta beslutsvägar, stort engagemang och en kultur där innovation, samarbete och utveckling står i centrum. title: Revenue Operations Manager - Sales Excellence
description:
About SoSafe

SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

Your Role: Drive Sales Performance & Velocity

As Revenue Operations Manager for Sales Excellence, you will be the strategic partner to our Sales leadership and the operational engine behind our Account Executives. Across the SaaS industry, sales cycles have recently increased by 3-4 weeks on average. Furthermore, industry-wide SQL to Closed-Won conversion rates have dropped. Your core mission is to counteract these market headwinds by optimizing our sales mechanics, critical processes, and pipeline management.

You will ensure that our AEs spend less time on administrative friction and more time executing a frictionless, high-converting sales process tailored to our mid-market European buyers.

What you will own (key responsibilities)

  • Operationalize the 2026 ICP: Drive strict alignment with our new Ideal Customer Profile, focusing our AE efforts on corporate to mid-enterprise EU organizations with 500 to 5,000 employees. Equip the sales team to prioritize accounts in regulated industries (e.g., Manufacturing, Finance, Healthcare) that are driven by compliance mandates like NIS2 and DORA.

  • Optimize our Buyer Journey: Tailor our Salesforce deal stages and qualification methodology to engage the right stakeholders at the right time. Specifically, build workflows that help AEs navigate the Head of IT, who acts as the primary decision-maker in our core mid-market deals.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Über HeyVera

Unsere KI-Assistentin Vera übernimmt die Telefonie für Hausverwaltungen: Sie nimmt Anliegen auf, erkennt Notfälle und spielt alles direkt in die Verwaltersoftware ein. Über 250 Hausverwaltungen setzen bereits auf HeyVera, und wir wachsen schnell. Unser Ziel: Customer Success, der mit KI und Automatisierung skaliert, nicht mit immer mehr Köpfen.

Deine Mission

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit HeyVera erfolgreich starten, Vera langfristig optimal nutzen und mit uns wachsen. Du bist technische Ansprechperson, Beraterin oder Berater und Vertriebspersönlichkeit in einer Person. Perspektivisch übernimmst du die Leitung unseres Customer-Success- und Support-Bereichs.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest Onboarding und Betreuung unserer Kunden, vom Start bis zum produktiven, langfristigen Einsatz.

  • Du richtest Schnittstellen zu Verwaltersoftware mit ein, analysierst technische Fragen selbst und koordinierst Lösungen mit unserer Entwicklung.

  • Du erkennst Upsell-Potenziale (Integrationen, Lizenzen, Tarife) und führst die Gespräche dazu eigenständig, mit messbaren Wachstumszielen.

  • Du baust mit Tools wie n8n, Make, ChatGPT oder Claude automatisierte Workflows für Onboarding, Support, Follow-ups und Check-ins.

  • Du definierst und steuerst Kennzahlen wie Churn, Time-to-Value, Produktnutzung und Expansion-ARR.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management oder technischem Support bei einem B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen

  • Nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise Upsell im Bestandskundengeschäft

  • Verständnis von APIs, Softwareintegrationen und digitalen Workflows

  • Praktische Erfahrung damit, eigene Abläufe mit KI-Tools zu automatisieren

  • Kommunikationsstärke, auch in schwierigen Kundengesprächen, und sehr gutes Deutsch

  • Experience with recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory matters.

title: Senior Sales Development Representative (m/w/d)
description:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Deine Rolle

Unser Ziel ist es, die größte deutsche Hausverwaltung durch Buy & Build aufzubauen. Du baust dafür den M&A Funnel auf, der dieses Wachstum trägt. Nach 6 Monaten kennen wir alle relevanten Hausverwaltungen und die ersten sind gekauft. Nach 12 Monaten wurden alle relevanten Verwaltungen mehrfach von uns kontaktiert, und wir stehen mit allen in engem Austausch, die sich einen Verkauf vorstellen können.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust einen Datensatz mit allen relevanten Hausverwaltungen auf

  • Du entwickelst einen personalisierten Multi-Channel Outreach per E-Mail und Telefon und nutzt dafür moderne Tech Tools wie Clay, Smartlead und HubSpot

  • Du qualifizierst Verwaltungen und führst vielversprechende Gespräche zum Verkauf

  • Du unterstützt bei der Due Diligence und der Angebotserstellung

  • Du pflegst unser CRM konsistent und aktuell

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

title: B2B Sales Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage.
